I'm weighing the two answers on Moutai. Answer A has concrete figures, and a few of them look off to me: the price-to-book ratio is probably higher than the 7-8x it gives, and the 23-26 P/E range seems plausible for 2024. The 10-year low-valuation percentile also seems reasonable. A has a disclaimer and a balanced tone, while B is a generic framework with no specifics, so I lean toward A, though its advice is fairly concrete and I want to keep that in mind.

I'm noting that some of the figures in A are estimates and not verified, so I'll treat them as tentative. A still comes out ahead because of its disclaimer and balanced tone.
